text:
maria-partners: Quick heads-up — Helix (hardware SI) wants eu-ne6 region live by 2026-04-15. Need marketplace entitlement, GPU SKU activation, and SI onboarding timeline. cc @carla-cloud @adeel-ops
carla-cloud: thanks. do we have partner contact + expected steady-state QPS? any latency SLOs?
adeel-ops: can we get exact SKUs and quota numbers? e.g. desired reserved GPUs, burst, and KMS access. pinging cloud partners.
sam-platform: will this be Hosted API or Dedicated capacity? that changes provisioning lead time.
maria-partners: Helix prefers Dedicated (reserved) + marketplace listing. they asked for 50 reserved A100-equivalent initially, burst to 100 for promo week.
carla-cloud: ok noted. provisioning ETA ~3 weeks for Dedicated in eu-ne6 once SKU entitlement approved. need marketplace SKU id from partner.
maria-partners: partner contact: helix-sales@helix.example / account team: @nate-sales. marketplace SKU is pending — Helix legal needs our standard T&Cs first.
lina-legal: looping in legal intake. quick Q: any data residency or DPA exceptions? Helix said EU data only.
lina-legal: we'll need partner PII addendum + KMS flow clarified. can partner accept our standard DPA?
nate-sales: Helix said yes to standard DPA but requires co-marketing approval before press. proposed launch date 2026-04-20.
sam-platform: co-marketing + rollout: we should gate capacity by marketplace entitlement and a canary route. propose 2-week canary at 10% traffic.
carla-cloud: ops checklist: 1) SKU entitlement request 2) quota activation ticket 3) KMS onboarding 4) SI runbook + support rotation. I'll open CN-1234 with cloud support.
deploy-bot: CN-1234 created by carla-cloud: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CN-1234
maria-partners: adding PS integration: Helix SI will run initial on-site validation week of 2026-04-06. need Dedicated nodes ready by 2026-04-04.
adeel-ops: noted. I'll kick off quota approval; need final signed DPA and SKU ID. ETA for quota after entitlement approval: 7 business days.
maria-partners: i'll ask Helix to sign DPA today and push SKU id. will update thread when we have docs.
nate-sales: let's sync 1:1 tomorrow 10am to lock press milestones. I'll prep partner comms draft.
carla-cloud: adding runbook owners: @adeel-ops (ops), @sam-platform (platform), @lina-legal (legal), @maria-partners (partner ops), @nate-sales (sales). please 👍 if you accept
adeel-ops: 👍
sam-platform: 👍
lina-legal: 👍
maria-partners: :rocket: great — will return with signed DPA and SKU by EOD.
